data.name: Flesh Rot
data.description: As a standard action, you can make a melee touch attack and expend 1 point of inspiration to cause the flesh of a living creature to rot and wither. If the attack hits, the target takes %1d8+%2 points of damage. If you miss with the melee touch attack, this power is wasted with no effect.|min(5,(InvestigatorLVL+1/4)|InvestigatorLVL
